messages.author: dfab579a94fa5c7b
messages.subject: get.ests warning message
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to use fitqtl to get estimated QTL effects. I have the following code:

out.fq2 <- fitqtl(all_data, pheno.col=4, qtl=qtl, formula= y~Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4:Q5, dropone=FALSE, get.ests=TRUE)

but I am getting the warning message:

Estimated QTL effects not yet made meaningful for this case.

Am I missing a step? Apologies if this has been asked before but I've not been able to find the solution.

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] get.ests warning message
parts:
Could you say more about the nature of the data, such as the type of cross?

For a four-way cross with interactions, it's not clear to me how best to encode the QTL effects, and so I think that's what the warning is about.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] get.ests warning message
parts:
You’re using a formula that includes interactions (“Q4:Q5” means to include the interaction between QTLs 4 and 5). The warning maybe concerns interactions with a QTL on the X chromosome.

karl

> On Aug 6, 2018, at 11:50 AM, mnbr...@sheffield.ac.uk wrote:
>
> It is a F2 intercross. Using fitqtl without get.ests worked fine and didn't show any significant interactions.
